title: The page-writer check finds the writer by its triage tag, not by a fixed session id
why: The pick guard (#3093) keys the page writer to a fixed session id. A new triage session gets a new id, so the key goes stale and the guard refuses the real writer. hooks/feedback_guard.py is_writer ignores the key, so the two checks can disagree on who the writer is.
source: lane pick-guard-cloud-writer notes 2 and 3, via coordinator 00:13 CST Nov 13
note: One home for "who writes the page": read the session tagged cs-build:triage and cs-repo:<repo> (get_session or list_sessions), and have is_writer and the pick guard call it. Red tests first: (a) a new triage session id passes, (b) is_writer and the pick guard agree. Unmeasured: whether a container restart (same session id, new worker) also stales the key; triage restarted three times tonight with the same id.
